old_narration: Numbering year starts has a month and day. We retain January first, the calendar year. For yearly patterns, a fiscal boundary starts a new sequence on that date. The help explains the year label: most fiscal years are named by their ending year, so a period beginning November first, 2026 is 2027. There is no separate start-year or end-year selector on this form. Monthly and daily call patterns use calendar dates. Review the month, day and guidance before changing an established scheme.
new_narration: Numbering year starts has a month and day. We retain January first, so our calls use the calendar year. A yearly format starts a new sequence at the selected boundary. For a fiscal year, confirm how your organization names that period before choosing the settings. The help gives November first, 2026 as an example of a period named 2027 by its ending year. Monthly and daily call patterns use calendar dates. Review the displayed next number after any authorized change.
